title: Orbit Garden
about: ORBIT GARDEN: hop a seed of light from orbit to orbit up a sky that turns from dawn to night, gathering light and minding the stones. One thumb, written in Sprout, in SPROUT·NOW's modern style.
line: A calm, modern one-thumb climber: tap to hop a seed of light between turning orbits as the sky turns from dawn to night. SPROUT·NOW's first game.
